task: Expand deterministic sitemap usability and inclusion scoring.
nonGoals: Frontend, existing Cloudflare services, paid services, full sitemap discovery, or rubric and wire-contract changes

outcomes.description: Inspect only bounded same-origin sitemap URLs through the existing public egress and robots policy, with limited index traversal.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen request bounds and blocked target scenarios

outcomes.description: Award evidence-backed sitemap credit only for confirmed usable and exact inclusion observations.

process.description: Separate branch, independent review and hosted CI. No existing Cloudflare or frontend changes.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse bounded retrieval and avoid new dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Sitemap scoring does not change workflow, portability or continuation.
